# Converted charm cards

The `.txt` and `.provenance.json` of The Fantastic Four and Varchild's War-Riders (triggered charms:
each option of `trigger 0` is a line keyed `trigger 0 option m`) and of Bow of Nylea (an activated
charm: its `activated` line declares `spell 1`, its options `spell 1 option m`), copied unchanged
from the gen-3 conversion at `output/effects/gen3/converted` written 2026-11-18 at repo 42b49a9e /
forge 2d5c8b90225. Kept apart from `gen3-sidecars/` because `make_fixture_records.py` empties that
directory and writes only the sidecars its records name. Read by
`tests/unit/effects/infrastructure/test_sidecar_join_contract.py`.
